title: Shaky Singer Sanju Rathod Recalls Sleeping At Train Station When He Had No Money | Bollywood News - News18
text: Marathi singer Sanju Rathod, who shot to fame with hits like Shaky Shaky and Gulabi Sadi, recently shared a candid look at his life before success. Before he became a well-known name in the Marathi music scene, Rathod faced severe financial struggles and personal hardships. He revealed that there was a time when he came to Mumbai with no money and had nowhere to stay. For 15 days, he slept at the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) railway station, surviving with just one blanket and dealing with the challenges of life on the streets. In his conversation with Zoom, he detailed not only his financial struggles but also the social pressures and harassment he endured while trying to make a name for himself in music. Hailing from Dhanwad, a small village in Maharashtra’s Jalgaon district, Rathod spoke about the challenges he faced while trying to establish himself in the music industry. “I was in debt. I came to Mumbai without any money. I slept at CSMT station for 15 days with only one blanket. I lost my phone and I was without a phone for nearly 5 to 6 months," he recounted. He also detailed the difficulties of borrowing money to fund his music. “Initially, I used to do songs for Ganpati Bappa every year. My songs would get 10-15 million views even back then when YouTube wasn’t as popular. I didn’t know much about YouTube, and I didn’t have an account. I used to take loans from friends and family to make videos. My videos would go viral, and people would say, ‘Look, he’s making so much money.’ But the truth is, I was struggling." Rathod recalled the harassment he endured from people outside his home during these difficult periods. “People would stand outside my house and abuse me. I’d hide on the terrace, behind the water tank, and literally jump down to escape. There are many stories like that. But now, it’s all forgiven," he said. Sanju Rathod first gained widespread attention with Gulabi Sadi, released in February 2024, which he wrote and composed. The music video featured Prajakta Ghag and contributed to his growing popularity. His 2025 single Shaky Shaky, featuring actress Isha Malviya, blends Marathi folk, indie pop, and Afrobeat elements. Rathod wrote, composed, and performed the track, which was produced by G-Spark. Shaky Shaky has become Rathod’s fourth song to surpass 100 million views on YouTube. The track recently reached the No. 1 spot on YouTube’s Top 100 Music Videos Global chart, overtaking international artists such as Ed Sheeran, Rose, and Bruno Mars. Beyond these hits, Rathod is also known for songs like Kali Bindi, Nauvari, Bulletwali, and his Bappa Wala Gana series.
